summary.text: Joy Goeben is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 5 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her current term as beginning on January 3, 2023.

paragraphs.text: Joy Goeben was born in Wisconsin and graduated from Green Bay East High School, according to Ballotpedia.
She earned a bachelor's degree in education from the University of Wisconsin, Green Bay, and a master's degree in education from Walden University.
Her career experience includes working as a teacher in the Ashwaubenon School District, owning a childcare center and working at a family business.

Goeben was assigned to the Children and Families, Education (vice-chair), Environment (chair), Housing and Real Estate, Jobs and the Economy, and Regulatory Licensing Reform committees for the 2025-2026 legislative session.
